s: Alt text: Visual → General → Alt text; use a measure for dynamic text ("Net sales {value}, {change} vs last year").
Tab order: View → Selection pane → Tab order; hide decorative shapes from tab order.
Colour: add icons, data labels or text for status; check contrast with a checker.
Test: keyboard (Ctrl+F6 to the page, Tab between visuals, Ctrl+Right to enter), then Narrator/NVDA.
mod-report-0.check: Alt text everywhere, logical tab order, no colour-only meaning, keyboard-only use works.
